currency_note: 以下费率为公开口径整理的参考默认值，各平台会按类目、店铺类型、站点和活动调整。用于经营测算，实际扣费以平台结算单为准；你可以在工作台中按自己的类目修改这些数值。
currency_note_en: These are reference rates compiled from public sources. Platforms adjust them by category, store type, site and promotion. Use them for business estimates; actual charges follow the platform settlement statement. You can edit these values for your own categories.
